pages.text: Reads the inventory of a block, such as a chest.

You get one ITEM_STACK (id, count) per slot. An empty slot has the id "" and the count 0. A block without inventory raises INVALID_ARGUMENT. An empty $(1)dimension$() in the position means the dimension of the trigger block.
$(li)$(1)position$() STRUCT c0de/minecraft/POSITION: where the block is$(li)result $(1)result$() ARRAY STRUCT c0de/minecraft/ITEM_STACK: the slots
$(1)CALL c0de/minecraft/GET_INVENTORY$(br)  PARAMETER position chest ;$(br)  RESULT result slots$()
